description: Builds a crossword puzzle with a hidden solution word from clue/answer pairs you write, and returns a text preview plus a clue-forge.com link where the user can view, edit and download it as a print-ready PDF/HTML. Use it for personalised puzzles (birthday, wedding, couples, Valentine's Day, Christmas, classroom, team events) or general-knowledge puzzles. Rules: answers are single words, 2–15 letters, no spaces; each letter of solution_word must occur in a different answer (add clues if a letter is missing); the answer must not appear in its clue; do not use the solution word itself as an answer. Write clues in the language given by "language". Always show the returned link to the user.

clues.description: Clue/answer pairs. Use at least as many pairs as the solution word has letters; 8–14 works best.

answer.description: Single-word answer. Accents and umlauts are converted automatically.

clue.description: The question shown to the solver.

language.description: Language of the clues and of the Clueforge interface. Defaults to "en".

occasion.description: Selects the matching theme in the editor. Defaults to "general".

solution_word.description: Hidden word revealed by the highlighted letters, e.g. a name like "ANNA" or "LOVE". 2–20 letters.

name: create_crossword
title: Create crossword
